# OuluREPO

> > OuluREPO is the University of Oulu's open access institutional repository for preserving, sharing, and discovering scholarly works, research publications, and academic theses.

OuluREPO serves as the digital archive for the University of Oulu, providing open access to research outputs including peer-reviewed articles, dissertations, and academic publications. The repository supports the university's commitment to research visibility and open science principles.

## Core Navigation

- [OuluREPO Homepage](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi): Main entry point for University of Oulu's open access institutional repository
- [Search & Discovery](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/discover): Search and discovery interface for finding publications and research in OuluREPO
- [Browse by Title](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/browse): Browse publications alphabetically by title in the repository
- [Collections](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/community-list): View all collections and organizational units in OuluREPO
- [Recent Submissions](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/recent-submissions): Latest additions to the OuluREPO institutional repository

## University Collections

- [University of Oulu Collection Hub](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/1): Primary collection hub containing all University of Oulu research outputs and scholarly works

## Research Publications

- [Impact of Hepatitis C Therapy on Urinary Outcomes and Renal Function](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61389): Prospective real-world cohort study on hepatitis C therapy effects on renal function
- [Sorväellei nommarähti mvyevih sämiela](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61388): Academic thesis on Sami language by Daniel Nicolas Heinimaa
- [Word Categorization and Definition Skills in Adolescents](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61387): Thesis examining word categorization and definition abilities in 13-14 year old youth
- [Rethinking the OLI Paradigm: Brand Community Capability in DNVB Internationalization](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61386): Academic thesis on OLI paradigm and brand community dynamics in international business expansion
- [Tracing Early Reindeer Dispersal in Southern Sweden](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61385): Zooarchaeological research on reindeer dispersal patterns in Paleolithic Sweden (12,000-7,000 BCE)
- [Goal-Oriented Wireless Sensor Networks: Error Exponent and Outage Analyses](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61384): Research on wireless sensor networks with distributed hypothesis testing capabilities
- [Temporal Trends in Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Mental Healthcare](https://oulurepo.oulu.fi/handle/10024/61383): Study analyzing mental healthcare utilization trends in child and adolescent psychiatry from 2013 to 2023
